name: Smart Merge AI
scope: All36 installed readable function bodies plus config registration/settings reviewed. Installed mod.cpp identity/description inspected. This is source semantic review, not complete CBE feature parity, runtime acceptance or measured cost.

dispositions.intent: Recover genuine casualty survivors rather than merge deliberate solo teams.
dispositions.source: Source checks peak combat history/other living members, isolation dwell/cooldown and optional explicit authorization. Pending destination suitability is rechecked on later callbacks.
dispositions.cbe: Existing casualty-only enqueue, peak-size threshold, remnant threshold and medical/task/mission protections retained. New job captures casualty-time living roster; later living additions or current size beyond remnant limit retire it. Direct jobs capture their initial roster once. Further losses may shrink scope.
dispositions.decision: Adapt continuous suitability and task membership scope into existing CBE owner, not source survivor polling/registries.

dispositions.intent: Approach a useful host which can absorb survivors without stealing specialised ownership.
dispositions.source: Target admission checks same-side or optional mutual alliance, optional faction, living/combat capacity, protection flags, reserved slots and range. Source scores distance plus faction/same-owner preferences.
dispositions.cbe: Current same-side/same-owner host selection, configured size/capacity and physical join distance retained. MOVE now rechecks host combat strength, side and own-regroup status; losing fitness returns to EVALUATE under original deadline. No automatic cross-side/faction integration added.
dispositions.decision: Implement the confirmed stale-host gap; reservation-provider helpers, faction/role policies and wider selection descendants remain to reconcile.

dispositions.intent: Finite approach and late cancellation should preserve newer task authority.
dispositions.source: updatePending reissues unit doMove on a cadence and may join at detection radius after timeout/stall; abortPending accepts an ownedMove boolean and current MOVE/empty command, then issues move-to-self/follow without exact destination/order proof. mergeUnit fires arbitrary veto/beforeMerge callbacks before membership mutation without a final post-callback full context check.
dispositions.cbe: Keep original CBE deadline, one retry, native/authored replacement guards, local membership and exact owned-MOVE cleanup. Do not import unowned repeated move/stop/follow, widened failure-time join authority or source hooks as command permission.
dispositions.decision: Reject unsafe mechanisms while retaining physical join/repeat/ownership verification as open requirements.

runtimeChanges.cost: One original survivor array retained in existing job; each callback compares current living members against it. MOVE counts combat-effective members of the already selected host, reusing its roster for live capacity. No new worker, world scan, geometry, setting or deadline; native roster/eligibility cost unmeasured.
remaining: Selected CBE task/host/cohort and native cleanup/physical joining/repeat/locality behaviour and performance remain unverified while audits are paused.
Same-owner live capacity is not a cross-owner distributed reservation protocol. Cross-side/faction/peaceful singleton/vehicle/civilian merging are not selected implicit expansions.
CBA/veto/event/settings counts and36 reviewed bodies do not score implementation or whole-mod parity.

allBodyDispositions.finding: Source uses local pending/survivor/registry lanes and a0.2s PFH. Retain prompt active-work service and bounded batches through CBE's existing event-driven regroup job; do not add another per-unit registry or PFH. Stop leaves the PFH installed for reactivation. Separate pending/survivor lane budgets and mandatory registry processing are not a strict global work limit; pressure/queue filtering precedes those limits.

All declared CBA controls/defaults reviewed. Keep CBE global/group regroup gates and deliberate-small-team protection. Do not automatically import peaceful singleton/vehicle/static/civilian or allied-side merging; those broaden task and side ownership. Same-faction preferences remain unselected rather than implied functionality.

Source Local/Killed/pressure EH registration, local arrays, singleton casualty authorization and peak combat history traced. CBE already queues casualty-only owner work and preserves a peak threshold. Original-cohort fix is implemented in01dcdaf4. Source locality-loss unregister skips abortPending when actor is no longer local, so its local reservation can survive removal; do not copy this as a safe provider handover.

Source tracks direct damage/fire/missile/own fire/native targets and nearby mutually allied pressure; mode2 bypasses pressure. These events are not permission to override a deliberate singleton mission. The nested group-casualty exitWith in hasDirectPressure exits its if block, not the function; its result is discarded. Default casualty authorization in processCandidate is a separate bypass, so this does not prove all source casualty regroup is broken. CBE retains explicit casualty-triggered scope and existing danger services.

Source protects humans/captives/unconscious/script tasks/static and combat crews, adds mission opt-outs and specific VR/object-name exclusions. Retain general CBE actor/group/mission/specialist boundaries; do not copy mission-specific names or class heuristics as universal ownership. Source framework allow flags bypass its framework protection, not all later eligibility.

Source checks host protection/capacity/friendship/faction/range repeatedly and scores distance/affiliation/owner/combat state. CBE retains same-side/same-owner and capacity policy. Original-cohort/live-host fitness fix is implemented; current patch additionally checks host Regroup enablement and clearance/garrison/defence/common-operation task boundaries both at selection and before join. Generic merging must not become an unauthenticated reinforcement path.

Source uses per-machine aggregate slot counts, isolation/search cooldowns and a timed chase. reserveGroup delta0 reads renew180s expiry; locality loss can strand an aggregate count and future reads can keep it alive. CBE retains same-owner live host capacity, original finite deadline and existing move lifecycle. Source timeout/stall can widen join distance; repeated doMove and ownedMove boolean are not exact new-order proof.

Source exposes before/after merge events and CODE vetoes, then joinSilent; no final full order/context recheck follows arbitrary callbacks. Abort may issue move-to-self/follow from ownedMove plus MOVE/empty state without exact goal identity. Retain CBE physical join/configured capacity and exact owned cleanup; no new arbitrary callback authority or forced remote join.

hostTaskPolicy20261027.change: Reuse host Regroup feature gate and clearance/garrison/defence/common-operation boundaries at candidate selection and MOVE before membership mutation. A task-assigned/opted-out host cannot receive an old remnant; reselection keeps the original deadline. Deliberate reinforcement remains separate.
hostTaskPolicy20261027.cost: Existing selected/candidate host reads only; no new search, worker, timer, setting or native command. Engine cost unmeasured.
